title: Refund Policy
intro: Our spices are ground fresh for each order, so we cannot restock returns. We will always make it right if something arrives wrong.

sections.heading: When we replace or refund
sections.body: We replace or refund an order if it arrives damaged, if you receive the wrong item, or if there is a genuine quality issue with the blend.

sections.heading: How to raise it
sections.body: Contact us within 24 hours of delivery with your order number and a photo of the issue. An unboxing video helps us resolve damage claims faster.

sections.heading: What we cannot accept
sections.body: Because every pack is ground to order and food-grade, we cannot accept returns of opened or correctly delivered products.

sections.heading: Refund timelines
sections.body: Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method and typically reach you within 5–7 working days.
